sections.heading: Type power
lines: Apple Acid, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Muddy Water, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Whirlpool also count as Poison for type matchups.
Grass moves also count as Poison for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acid, Acid Spray, Grass Knot, and Snap Trap: 2× stronger.
Apple Acid, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, Muddy Water, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Whirlpool: 1.5× stronger.
Poison Powder, Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, and Toxic: 100% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Poison-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Purify and Seed Flare change the field into Grassy Terrain.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: is shielded as by Baneful Bunker.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
